argv: What can cover what on the stage
replay-ceremony ui 5: a whisper stands under the line clear of pins and pictures; what is left of it is filed apart, and the two names at 320 px are said
ops.body: - What can cover what on the stage: a standing picture covers a note's pin at the same stop until the card; a tall stack can stand over the east end of the walk on the last view; the passed place's name on the last view is a large pill over the ground under the path (two names at 320 px sit over the pictures' row and the walk); a picture and that name can cover each other. With reduce motion and no bounds (a day of placeless moments) pictures are not drawn. A card is 204 px wide where it was 211 under about 341 px, to stay clear of the stack

argv: From the UI review (Nov 19, medium, U1)
replay-ceremony ui 1: the owner's Proceed (Nov 19) accepted it; a tap on a standing picture opens its moment, the replay held
